description: This file defines a debugging utility for MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) codes, including mappings from numeric codes to string names for operations, formats, object properties, and device properties within the Android media framework.

classes.name: CodeEntry
classes.description: Structure representing a mapping between a code name and its numeric value.

classes.name: MtpDebug
classes.description: Namespace containing functions to retrieve string names for various MTP codes.

methods.name: getCodeName
methods.description: Helper function to find the name corresponding to a code within a given table.

methods.name: getOperationCodeName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given MtpOperationCode.

methods.name: getFormatCodeName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given MtpObjectFormat.

methods.name: getObjectPropCodeName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given MtpPropertyCode related to object properties.

methods.name: getDevicePropCodeName
methods.description: Returns the string name for a given MtpPropertyCode related to device properties.
